set -eu

ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq 'inet 10.15.1.11/24 ' || ip address add 10.15.1.11/24 dev eth0

ip route replace default via 10.15.1.1 dev eth0

# Cache ARP statica per soli vicini dello stesso dominio L2 (riduce ICMP iniziali).
ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.1.1 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:01 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.1.12 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:03 nud permanent dev eth0

ip -4 neigh replace 10.15.1.14 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:05 nud permanent dev eth0

# Gateway ICMP warmup; bounded, not fatal if router is late. 
probe_attempt=0
while [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ]; do
  if ping -n -I eth0 -c 1 -W 1 10.15.1.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  probe_attempt=$((probe_attempt + 1))
  [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ] || break
  sleep 1
done

for i,z in enumerate(zones,1):
 if z"'!='"'.': out.append(f'check {z} {ips[i]}')
out += [f'check www.example.com {ips[6]}',f'check mail.company.com {ips[7]}',f'check mail.university.edu {ips[11]}',\"check company.com '10 mail.company.com.' MX\",\"check university.edu '10 mail.university.edu.' MX\",'exit \""'$fail"'"']
Path('shared/check-dns.sh').write_text('\\n'.join(out)+'\\n'); Path('shared/check-dns.sh').chmod(0o755)
print('Verified 31 zone files, 30 delegations and glue records, both MX records, and all target addresses.')
